description: This file defines the AWS Route53ResolverClient class, which extends the AwsClient class. It serves as a client interface for interacting with the Amazon Route 53 Resolver service, providing method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, associating, and fetching resolver configurations and rules. The class is part of the AWS SDK for PHP and utilizes method annotations to declare the available methods and their asynchronous equivalents.

classes.name: Route53ResolverClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Route 53 Resolver service, providing methods to manage firewall rules, resolver endpoints, log configurations, and associated resources.

methods.name: associateFirewallRuleGroup
methods.description: Associates a firewall rule group with a VPC or resource.

methods.name: associateFirewallRuleGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a firewall rule group.
